**Beta** — fixes for 1.8.0. Only offered to users who turn on beta versions for YidStore.

- **Updates show up right away.** Opening an item's details checks its releases live. If a newer version is out, you see **Update available** and an **Update** button straight away, without waiting for the next update check.
- **Home Assistant's own restart dialog.** Restart now opens Home Assistant's native restart dialog right on the page, without going to Settings.
- **Restart required no longer sticks.** After you restart, the message clears and the updated integration runs.
- **Updating doesn't ask you to set up.** The setup wizard only opens after a fresh install, like the Marketplace.
- **Configure in YidStore.** Set-up integrations get a **Configure** button that opens their settings in the same dialog.

Note: pre-releases (betas) of an integration are only offered when **Beta releases** is on in YidStore's menu.
